text:
emily-support: urgent escalation from AcmeHealth — they saw a sudden onboarding batch this morning and ~30% of requests returned gateway 504 / timeouts for ~10m. They say it happens right after a traffic burst and clears after ~1-2 minutes. Raised customer ticket with IDs: RQ-4421, RQ-4422. Can we triage? cc @noa-oncall @jason-eng

noa-oncall: acked. can you paste a couple of request IDs + sample gateway logs? I’ll open an incident channel.

emily-support: pasted: RQ-4421, RQ-4422. Gateway logs show repeated "upstream request timed out" and 504s from gateway between 08:12:04-08:14:37. Linking logs: https://logs.redwood/acme/rq-4421

jason-eng: quick litmus — did keda/hpa fire? any scale events? Also which model image (v2.3.1?) and deployment pool?

rahul-sre: grabbing metrics now. preliminary: queue depth (inference-queue) spiked from 2 -> 46 at 08:12:02. pods stayed at 1 for ~30s, then went to 4 after ~35s, and reached 6 at ~08:13:30. avg pod CPU stayed low (~15%). HPA cpu target 70% so it didn’t trigger early. KEDA scaled on queue length but activation threshold looks off.

maria-runtime: found readiness/init timings in pod logs for the affected startup: model-loader start -> download + quantize step ~18s, warmup tokenization ~9s, readiness probe configured as initialDelay=5s period=5s, so probe failed until ~32s after start. While pod is NotReady, gateway still routes to activator which proxies 504s. Logs: 
```
[08:12:03] pod/ri-runtime-012 start model-fetch
[08:12:06] model-fetch -> 403 billing.auth failed for model artifact
[08:12:07] retrying model-fetch
[08:12:21] model loaded, warmup done, ready
```

jason-eng: interesting — two issues lining up: (1) KEDA/HPA decision boundary: ScaledObject shows `activationThreshold: 100` and `pollingInterval: 30` (we only reached 46 requests -> KEDA didn’t scale quickly). (2) model init + readiness probe mismatch + a transient 403 during model fetch that caused retries and extended init. Together they created a handoff/warmup gap.

alex-billing: looked at auth logs: token rotation occurred at 08:11:59 for the artifact registry token (short-lived key). First model fetch after rotation returned 403 for ~6s before refresh path recovered. There’s a renewal race when the image/service-token rotates rapidly during bursts. Logged: `artifact-fetch 403 \"quota/unauth\"`.

rahul-sre: repro steps I ran in staging: flood queue to 50 reqs/s against staging scaledobject with `activationThreshold=100` -> no immediate scale, backlog grows, pods start cold-loading models -> readiness delay 20-35s -> gateway timeouts. Repro script: `siege -c 60 -t 45s https://staging.api/redwood/infer` (we used mocked model artifact slow response).

jason-eng: short-term mitigations we can push ASAP:
- lower ScaledObject `activationThreshold` 100 -> 10
- set `pollingInterval` 30 -> 5 (for bursty onboarding workloads)
- add KEDA `minReplicaCount: 2` for onboarding route
- increase gateway request timeout slightly to cover expected cold-start (temporary)

maria-runtime: medium-term fixes we should schedule:
- add init-container to prefetch artifact and fail fast on auth errors (so we can surface 403 as infra alert instead of prolonged retries)
- change readiness probe initialDelay to 40s for this model profile OR implement a warmup-ready signal separate from k8s probe
- implement model artifact token refresh check in runtime to avoid first-fetch 403 race

noa-oncall: fine. I’ll open a PR for the ScaledObject patch (activationThreshold + pollingInterval + minReplicaCount) and a temporary gateway timeout bump. tagging @deploy-bot to run canary.

deploy-bot: deploy started for: keda/scale-patch PR#374, gateway-timeout PR#375 -> canary to 3 pods in prod routing group onboarding-v2. Rolling patch ETA ~7m.

maria-runtime: after patch (canary) we see staging replay: with activationThreshold=10 + pollingInterval=5, scale to 5 pods in ~8s and readiness/handoff window closed. Also added prefetch init-container in canary runtime image which surfaced a 403 to alert channel instead of hidden retries.

alex-billing: we also pushed a fix to token rotation so token TTL refresh happens 10s earlier; reduces 403 window. Need postmortem on token TTL config.

emily-support: updated customer (AcmeHealth) at 09:05 — they confirmed errors dropped to near zero after rollout, they’re ok with the short-lived outage. Customer asked for RCA and a note about preventing recurrence.

jason-eng: next steps for postmortem: add to issue tracker -> root cause: KEDA activationThreshold too high for onboarding workload + token-rotation auth race caused model-init retry storm + readiness mismatch. Actions: PRs merged for ScaledObject defaults, init-container prefetch, token-rotation TTL bump, add alert when queue backlog > 20 for >15s, and add a cold-start SLO for onboarding routes. Owner: rahul-sre. ETA: doc + RCA by EOD tomorrow.

noa-oncall: incident closed for now. Will monitor 6h. :white_check_mark:

emily-support: thanks everyone — customer follow-up email sent. Keep me posted if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
